description: Tasks for upgrading distributed-ecommerce from Java 21 to Java 25 LTS.

tasks.description: Upgrade the project runtime and build target from Java 21 to Java 25 LTS.
tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest generally available LTS release as of 2026-11-17; the project currently targets Java 21.
tasks.requirements: Update the root Maven java.version property to 25 and keep maven.compiler.release and the compiler plugin release aligned with it. Update the Maven project description. Add project-level Maven toolchain enforcement to select JDK 25 without committing machine-specific JDK paths, and document the per-user ~/.m2/toolchains.xml setup and toolchain verification. Update Java runtime references and setup instructions in README.md, docs/adr/ADR-001-technology-stack.md, and docs/architecture/system-architecture.md. Preserve the existing architecture and dependency versions unless a demonstrated Java 25 incompatibility requires a minimal fix. Validate Maven/toolchain selection, effective compiler release 25, a root mvn clean verify, class-file major version 69, and removal of stale active Java 21 requirements.

tasks.description: Scan project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate any findings.
tasks.reason: The modernization plan's standard security check verifies the dependency set after the runtime upgrade.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs after the Java runtime upgrade. Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched versions; if a fix requires a major version change, document the affected dependency, current and upgraded versions, and breaking-change risk. Confirm the project builds and all tests pass after remediation.
